phase: ROADMAP Stage 2B: retrieval eval suite validator/template v1
implemented: Added SUPPORTED_FILTER_KEYS and server.validate_retrieval_suite(suite) for DB-free, corpus-free eval suite shape validation.

Validator checks suite object shape, optional suite/name strings, non-empty cases, unique non-empty case ids, non-empty queries, supported filter keys, integer min_authority, normalized format values, and at least one non-empty relevance target list among relevant_titles/relevant_chunk_ids/relevant_chunk_markers.
Validator returns passed, errors, warnings, case_count, filter_keys_used, and relevance_target_counts. Structural errors fail validation; warnings do not.
Validator warns when case_count is below 50 or suite metadata marks the data as placeholder/synthetic. Unknown formats warn against SUPPORTED_FORMATS rather than failing.
Added tools/validate_retrieval_suite.py with --suite and --json. Exit 0 means no errors, exit 1 means validation errors, and exit 2 means the suite could not be loaded.

Added tests/test_suite_validator.py covering valid shape, duplicate ids, missing query, unsupported filters, missing/empty relevance targets, min_authority parsing, format warnings, small/placeholder warnings, marker-only targets, shipped placeholder suite behavior, and CLI exit behavior.
Updated README, ROADMAP, and docs/RETRIEVAL_EVALUATION.md to document the validator while keeping the real 50-100 anonymized eval suite marked as not yet built.
codex_adjustments: Changed the invalid-suite CLI test to use tempfile.TemporaryDirectory instead of writing a scratch JSON file under tests/data, so tests remain reliable in restricted or read-only fixture directories.
Replaced Claude's mojibake CODEX_HANDOFF.json content with ASCII JSON and recorded actual Codex verification results.
not_implemented: A real 50-100 case anonymized retrieval/claim-verification suite is still not built; the shipped 10-case suite remains synthetic placeholder data.
The validator checks structure only. It does not prove relevance labels are semantically correct, does not verify anonymization quality, and does not resolve markers against a corpus or DB.
Vector retrieval, embeddings, reranking, semantic entailment, and conflict detection remain pending.
test_commands: python -m py_compile backend/server.py tests/test_library.py tests/test_frontend_ui.py tools/evaluate_retrieval.py tools/run_quality_gates.py tests/test_quality_gates.py tools/validate_retrieval_suite.py tests/test_suite_validator.py
test_status: Codex verified on Windows review repo: py_compile passed using an isolated PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX; unittest discover ran 118 tests OK; validate_retrieval_suite on tests/data/retrieval_eval_suite.json returned passed=true with expected placeholder and case_count<50 warnings; run_quality_gates.py --json returned passed=true with 5 gates passed; git diff --check passed; secret scan found no matches.
dependencies: Validator CLI and helper remain Python standard library only.
review_notes: The validator is intentionally an early structural gate for a future human-built suite, not a quality claim about the existing placeholder suite.
Warnings are used for small/placeholder data to keep the existing placeholder regression suite runnable while preventing readers from mistaking it for a real benchmark.
SUPPORTED_FILTER_KEYS mirrors the current retrieval filter contract; SUPPORTED_FORMATS is reused from import/search normalization.
risks: Unknown format values are warnings rather than hard failures. This preserves forward compatibility but means downstream docs must keep saying validator pass is only structural.
Real eval-suite construction remains the major Stage 2B gap.
